    Profile

    Anastasia is a knight with the nickname Blossom. She's utilized by her country as a sort of secret weapon. Since she was only sent into battle on the rarest occasions, and because she would cut her enemies down in the instant anyone laid eyes on her, there is very little information about her. Her silhouette dashing across the battlefield is as beautiful as a flower. She's mysterious and wise.

    Origin: Wratharis
    Gender: Female
    Height: 167cm
    Weight: 53kg
    Birthday: Dec 12
    Blood Type: Type Pa
    Zodiac: Moon of the Nightmare Cherry Blossom
    Likes: Blue and purple roses
    Hobbies: Metal carving
    Illust: ―
    CV: 小清水亜美
